digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC Jira adapter resilience and config validation
propositions: Cloud transport lacks per-member 429-retry enumeration and boundary classification that DC has; four distinct 429 behaviors exist across REST/subprocess/dispatch layers with split retry policies that require per-layer assertions rather than uniform attempt-count checks
Cloud performs no config-validation (non-HTTPS URL rejection, missing-credential fail-loudly) whereas DC validates both; silent credential degradation mirrors bug cd78

Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES without runtime configurability while DC threads resolved_statuses from settings; parity requires deciding whether Cloud deployments can rename resolved workflow states without code change

DC user-search method gracefully degrades when methods are absent but this is not asserted on DC; bare-urlopen member acli_cli_ops.update_priority bypasses _rest_urlopen_with_retry entirely and lacks 429-retry coverage
Enumeration of every mutating Cloud transport member across both axes (transport seam and dispatch level) must precede any assertion to prevent future mutations inheriting retry by omission

Implementation delivered: three test modules with per-member 429 sweep, config-validation coverage, user-search degradation pin, plus follow-up tickets for non-HTTPS rejection bug, missing-credential silent bug, and probe config-hook story
